data.body: ROOT CAUSE CONFIRMED (ADVANCED code-tracer): handle_type_check (_handle_type.py:53) returns True for every issue when type_mapping={} because mapping.get(any_type) always returns None on an empty dict. The filter at bridge-inbound.py:447-451 then produces empty creatable_issues, so write_create_events writes nothing. Fix: add 'if not type_mapping: return False' after the empty-jira_type check in _handle_type.py. Historical: jira-dig-1..1682 were created pre-2026-04-12 (no type gate) or while INBOUND_TYPE_MAPPING var was set. Repo var cleared ~2026-05-02, fallback {} engaged. Side effect: orphan BRIDGE_ALERT-only dirs created per filtered issue.
